title: Behind the scenes of iOS and Mac Security
summary: Ivan Krstic's Black Hat talk on Apple platform security, including the Find My design that uses elliptic curve key diversification to locate offline devices privately. It also covers hardware features such as the T2 chip and secure boot hardening.
why: Recommended as a rare insider look at Apple's security architecture and the reasoning behind its hardware choices.

quote.text: Good talk behind the reason for the T2 chip and some other Apple security stuff
